name: lygo-asset-foundry
description: Local agent-callable game asset pipeline: contract-aware Qwen-Image generation, magenta cutouts, sprite sheets, tile validation, manifests, queue worker, MCP, and Unity export. No auto-publish; no 3D claims without real 3D weights.

skill.subprocess: only the local foundry CLI and the explicitly requested image/queue commands

filesystem.read: <DRIVE_D>\LYGO\asset-foundry, configured engine/model paths, requested input pack
filesystem.write: <DRIVE_D>\LYGO\asset-foundry\packs, queue, logs, and the requested ingest destination
